the development of a novel silicated inositol complex for the treatment of insulin-resistant conditions, including the metabolic syndrome, diabetes, and polycystic ovarian syndrome.
the role of arginine in the development and progression of insulin resistance and the metabolic syndrome.
the role of nitric oxide in the pathogenesis of the metabolic syndrome.
